summary: CapsoVision filed an 8-K on September 17, 2026, disclosing a securities purchase agreement for a registered direct offering of 3,163,444 common shares at $5.69 per share, a roughly 5% discount to the September 16 close. Gross proceeds are about $18 million, with no underwriter or placement agent. Purchasers are existing holders: Star One Global (878,734 shares, ~$5.0 million), Eliyahou Harari (1,757,469 shares, ~$10.0 million, a related person), plus one sub-5% holder (527,241 shares, ~$3.0 million). Closing is expected on or about September 18, 2026.
